scores.visual_critic_note: The UI chrome is clean and well-typeset with a harmonious muted palette, but the circle-pack visualization is cropped at the bottom edge of the viewport and the edge bundles collapse into an illegible tangle of dark lines in the center, failing the 'does it work at rendered size' gate.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Correctly uses scaleSqrt for force-layout circle area, data-driven domains via d3.extent, key functions on data joins (d => d.id), and no deceptive encodings — the few honesty checks (zero baseline, dual-axis) are inapplicable to this topology layout.
scores.stress_test_note: Core interaction hygiene is thoughtful (transition interrupt handler, FPS counter, force-drag cleanup) but un-throttled slider events can fire expensive redraws or restart 1500ms transitions at 60fps, and missing .interrupt() calls risk mid-morph shape artifacts on rapid layout switching.
scores.cognitive_load_note: The circle-pack hierarchy reads clearly with 2–3 distinguishable color groups, but 300 cross-hierarchy edge bundles converging at the center create a dense hairball that makes individual connections impossible to trace without hover interaction — network density overwhelms the otherwise clean layout.
